title: Forlorn in the U.S.A.
主要内容: The pending takeover of Louisiana utility Cleco highlights the challenges faced by infrastructure investors in the U.S., emphasizing the need for long-term commitment when dealing with state-approved transactions. The $3.4 billion take-private deal, announced in October 2014, has not closed as planned, with a targeted closure date in the second half of 2015. The Louisiana Public Service Commission could decide its fate as soon as Wednesday.
